methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The main objective of the paper is to expand the proposed TS-CP-EEO approach from the plant orientation to the community one and add the sustainability dimension in order to integrate the corresponding formal management systems and establish the comprehensive Total Site Resource Efficiency System (TSRES).

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents a sustainability and management-system framework, but no identifiable or characterised EnPI/EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: Therefore, the novel TSRES is proposed within the paper.

stage1.notes: The industrial-laundry case reports optimisation outcomes, but does not define an energy-performance indicator, baseline, variables, or measurement-model construction.
